{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''luxury hunting lodge''' operated business on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], a Bothan [[clan]] hired a team of individuals to embark on an all-expenses-paid [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] trip, including a stay at the luxury [[Hotel/Legends|lodge]], to capture a pair of wild [[krak'jya]] beasts. To sweeten the deal, the agents were offered an extra two-[[Standard week/Legends|week]] stay at the lodge following the conclusion of the hunt.

The hunt was eventful, as the hunters returned with a wounded [[Unidentified Bothan Imperial agent|hunting guide]] and pursued by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] combat [[snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]]. In the lodge they regrouped but a dozen of the remaining Imperials surrounded and sieged them. It turned out that the guide was an Imperial agent, and having recovered, she made her move, revealing it was she who set them up. Equipped with a small [[remote detonator]], she ambushed the hunters from behind, only to be neutralized in the end. Then they found the detonator, and dashed out moments before the lodge exploded.
